title: wslog: Refactor the API with a msg manifest

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • f475a6d7 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 46f6febd - Add portability wrapper for localtime_r()
  • 549d76b9 - wslog: Refactor the API with a msg manifest
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/11923/diffs?diff_id=777590139&start_sha=036ceb19192ecb2400b6974fa16980290e00af86)

changes_data.diff:
@@ -83,6 +83,10 @@ endif()
 check_symbol_exists("clock_gettime"  "time.h"   HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME)
 # Some platforms (macOS pre 10.15) are non-conformant with C11 and lack timespec_get()
 check_symbol_exists("timespec_get"   "time.h"   HAVE_TIMESPEC_GET)
+if(NOT MSVC)
+	check_symbol_exists("localtime_r"    "time.h"   HAVE_LOCALTIME_R)
+	check_symbol_exists("tzset"          "time.h"   HAVE_TZSET)
+endif()
 check_function_exists("getifaddrs"       HAVE_GETIFADDRS)
 check_function_exists("issetugid"        HAVE_ISSETUGID)
 check_function_exists("setresgid"        HAVE_SETRESGID)

@@ -49,6 +49,12 @@
 /* Define to 1 if you have the `timespec_get` function. */
 #cmakedefine HAVE_TIMESPEC_GET 1
 
+/* Define to 1 if you have the `localtime_r` function. */
+#cmakedefine HAVE_LOCALTIME_R 1
+
+/* Define to 1 if you have the `tzset` function. */
+#cmakedefine HAVE_TZSET 1
+
 /* Define to use the MaxMind DB library */
 #cmakedefine HAVE_MAXMINDDB 1
